1: // Nebula Escape – minimal canvas game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Set canvas size (full window)
10:   const resize = () => {
11:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
12:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
13:   };
14:   resize();
15:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
16: 
17:   // Game settings
18:   const SHIP_WIDTH = 40;
19:   const SHIP_HEIGHT = 20;
20:   const SHIP_SPEED = 4;
21:   const BOOST_SPEED = 8;
22:   const BOOST_FUEL_COST = 0.3;
23:   const FUEL_DEPLETION = 0.02; // per frame
24:   const ASTEROID_SIZE = 30;
25:   const ASTEROID_SPEED = 2;
26:   const FUELCELL_SIZE = 20;
27:   const FUELCELL_SPEED = 2;
28:   const SPAWN_ASTEROID_EVERY = 90; // frames
29:   const SPAWN_FUELCELL_EVERY = 300; // frames
30: 
31:   // Game state
32:   const state = {
33:     ship: { x: canvas.width / 2 - SHIP_WIDTH / 2, y: canvas.height - SHIP_HEIGHT - 10, width: SHIP_WIDTH, height: SHIP_HEIGHT, fuel: 100, boosting: false },
34:     asteroids: [],
35:     fuelCells: [],
36:     frame: 0,
37:     gameOver: false,
38:   };
39: 
40:   // Input handling
41:   const keys = {};
42:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
43:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
44: 
45:   const rectsIntersect = (a, b) =>
46:     a.x < b.x + b.width && a.x + a.width > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.height && a.y + a.height > b.y;
47: 
48:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
49:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - ASTEROID_SIZE);
50:     state.asteroids.push({ x, y: -ASTEROID_SIZE, width: ASTEROID_SIZE, height: ASTEROID_SIZE });
51:   };
52: 
53:   const spawnFuelCell = () => {
54:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - FUELCELL_SIZE);
55:     state.fuelCells.push({ x, y: -FUELCELL_SIZE, width: FUELCELL_SIZE, height: FUELCELL_SIZE });
56:   };
57: 
58:   const update = () => {
59:     if (state.gameOver) return;
60:     const s = state.ship;
61:     // Move ship
62:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) s.x -= SHIP_SPEED;
63:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) s.x += SHIP_SPEED;
64:     // Keep within bounds
65:     s.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - s.width, s.x));
66:     // Boost
67:     s.boosting = keys['Space'];
68:     if (s.boosting && s.fuel > 0) {
69:       s.y -= BOOST_SPEED;
70:       s.fuel -= BOOST_FUEL_COST;
71:     } else {
72:       s.y -= SHIP_SPEED; // normal forward movement
73:     }
74:     // Fuel consumption
75:     s.fuel -= FUEL_DEPLETION;
76:     if (s.fuel <= 0) s.fuel = 0;
77: 
78:     // Scroll objects down relative to ship movement (keep ship near bottom)
79:     const scroll = Math.max(0, canvas.height - s.y - 100);
80:     if (scroll > 0) {
81:       s.y -= scroll;
82:       state.asteroids.forEach(a => (a.y += scroll));
83:       state.fuelCells.forEach(f => (f.y += scroll));
84:     }
85: 
86:     // Update asteroids
87:     state.asteroids.forEach(a => (a.y += ASTEROID_SPEED));
88:     state.asteroids = state.asteroids.filter(a => a.y < canvas.height);
89: 
90:     // Update fuel cells
91:     state.fuelCells.forEach(f => (f.y += FUELCELL_SPEED));
92:     state.fuelCells = state.fuelCells.filter(f => f.y < canvas.height);
93: 
94:     // Collisions
95:     for (const a of state.asteroids) {
96:       if (rectsIntersect(s, a)) {
97:         state.gameOver = true;
98:         return;
99:       }
100:     }
101:     for (let i = state.fuelCells.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
102:       const f = state.fuelCells[i];
103:       if (rectsIntersect(s, f)) {
104:         s.fuel = Math.min(100, s.fuel + 30);
105:         state.fuelCells.splice(i, 1);
106:       }
107:     }
108: 
109:     // Spawn new objects
110:     if (state.frame % SPAWN_ASTEROID_EVERY === 0) spawnAsteroid();
111:     if (state.frame % SPAWN_FUELCELL_EVERY === 0) spawnFuelCell();
112: 
113:     // Game over by fuel
114:     if (s.fuel <= 0) state.gameOver = true;
115: 
116:     state.frame++;
117:   };
118: 
119:   const draw = () => {
120:     // Clear
121:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
122:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
123: 
124:     // Ship
125:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
126:     const s = state.ship;
127:     ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.width, s.height);
128: 
129:     // Asteroids
130:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
131:     for (const a of state.asteroids) ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.width, a.height);
132: 
133:     // Fuel cells
134:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
135:     for (const f of state.fuelCells) ctx.fillRect(f.x, f.y, f.width, f.height);
136: 
137:     // HUD
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
139:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
140:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(s.fuel)}`, 10, 20);
141: 
142:     if (state.gameOver) {
143:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
144:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
145:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
146:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
147:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
148:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
149:     }
150:   };
151: 
152:   const loop = () => {
153:     if (!state.gameOver) update();
154:     draw();
155:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
156:   };
157:   loop();
158: })();

(End of file - total 158 lines)
